battle_start.text: So. The valley sends swords instead of grain. I expected it.
Come, then. My grandchildren are watching, and they are hungry.
You lock your grain and call us thieves. Now you come to finish it.

miss.text: Hah. The hill is crooked. Like your mayor.

crit.text: Forty winters I have bled for this clan. Your turn.

kill.text: Go down to the river. Tell it Skarrow sent you.

ally_down.text: Up, little one. Up. Ah. No.
ally_down.direction: the courtesy of the slow valley tongue falls away

low_hp.text: Not yet. The little ones have not eaten.
I have buried better than you. I will not be buried by you.

victory.text: Go home. Tell them the bridge stays ours until the grain comes.

defeat.text: Whatever you think of me, feed the little ones. Feed them.

town.text: Valley people. Walking. Not running at me with spears. This is new.
town.speaker: mother_skarrow
town.direction: cracked and rasping; slow, deliberate valley tongue, as a courtesy

town.text: Forty winters I have held this clan. Do not ask me if I can hold it one more.
town.speaker: mother_skarrow
town.direction: too sharp, and she knows it

town.text: Sit. You are guests now, which is worse than enemies. Guests we have to feed.
town.speaker: mother_skarrow
